# PakistanTravel.Agency
> Direct multi-vendor marketplace connecting travelers with licensed, independent local tour operators across Northern Pakistan.

## Overview
PakistanTravel (https://www.pakistantravel.agency) is an online guided tours platform specializing in experiential mountain travel across Gilgit-Baltistan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Azad Jammu & Kashmir. All tours are operated by registered local operators with verified CNIC details, local permits, transparent itineraries, and standard digital booking vouchers.

## Core Marketplace Sections
- Guided Tour Catalog: https://www.pakistantravel.agency/tours
- Regional Destination Guides: https://www.pakistantravel.agency/destinations
